channel.title: The Grant Desk - Media Arts, Film & Sound, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Media Arts, Film & Sound, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Grant: The Aftermath Project: 2026 Post-Conflict Photography Grant (USD 25,000) (closes 1 Dec)
item.description:
